detailed_description:
Photorealistic, continuous shot.
[Shot 1] <Subject 1> on the left and <Subject 2> on the right, already fully transformed in the opening frame, stand facing each other in profile at arm's length, chatting, with <Subject 1> resting his hands on his hips. At about one and a third seconds <Subject 1> reaches out with his right arm and playfully pats the top of <Subject 2>'s head, then steps back, and around two and a third seconds swings his arm in a big teasing arc over his head as he ducks and lifts a hand to block. From about three seconds they playfully grab each other's raised forearms and lock arms overhead, then at four seconds they spin half around with linked arms, <Subject 1> leaning back and laughing loudly as <Subject 2> pulls on his arm. Around five and a half seconds <Subject 1> doubles over with laughter while <Subject 2> pats his arm and laughs, then at about six seconds he spins away flailing one arm wide while <Subject 2> bends forward laughing, and at the end <Subject 1> is bent over low in the left foreground while <Subject 2> straightens up on the right, laughing. The handheld camera holds a steady medium-wide view with slight sway and pushes in a little closer from about four seconds. The camera follows the same path and framing as <Video 1>. Stable faces, stable outfits, natural body motion, the two characters never merge or swap identities, no identity drift, no morphing, no duplicated limbs.
Setting in <Video 1>: the target video takes place in <Subject 3>, an outdoor rooftop terrace in daytime in front of a large, dense, leafy green mango tree with a thick dark trunk on the right, a low concrete ledge with dark metal railings and a staircase railing behind, pale yellow building walls with a blue tarpaulin at the far right, grey sheeting on the left, and a pale, pebbled concrete floor.
Scene lighting on the performers in <Video 1>: soft, even, overcast daylight from above and the front, neutral-white colour temperature, no hard shadows, natural green-dominated colours and a bright, natural exposure.
Framing on the performers in <Video 1>: medium-wide shot showing both performers from the top of the head to about the knees, side by side in the centre of the frame; from about four seconds the camera is slightly closer, cutting them at the thighs, and when they bend over their heads drop low in the frame; the feet are never visible.
